topography.project_purpose: Suzaku is an Avalanche L1 and sovereign-network decentralization and (re)staking hub that connects builders, stakers, and operators.
topography.relationship_narrative: The SuzakuToken is the core liquid staking token, while LSTWrapper handles wrapping of staked assets. RewardsNativeToken distributes native token rewards, and BalancerValidatorManager manages validator operations, all supporting the restaking infrastructure.
